thesis: The tape is in a broad risk-off regime (VIX percentile 0.995, QQQ below its 50- and 200-day averages), and a small-cap biotech long swing is the wrong place to add risk. ADMA has been rejected at the 14.2 swing high, has closed lower two sessions in a row, and the post-earnings drift has no dated catalyst left. Insiders (CEO and a director) sold into the strength this week, and short interest near 10% of float plus an unverified short-seller attack mention add headline volatility. The 15.9 target needs a break of 14.2 that has just failed, and if only 14.2 is reached the card itself puts reward/risk near 1.5. In this regime, a stop-out under 12.40 on a gap or a market-wide flush is more likely than a clean measured move.
